roadmap: v0.7.0 — Freeze immutable packet and placement vectors
source: Deterministically generated by the in-repo test suite; no external media or third-party artifacts. This manifest describes every vector's derivation and the hand-verifiable wire fields; the full byte fixtures (<id>.hex) plus SHA-256 sidecars (<id>.hex.sha256) are materialized by the owner.
freeze_instructions: cargo test -p steganographer-core --test golden_vectors -- --ignored   (writes <id>.hex / <id>.hex.sha256 when absent; re-running it is a byte-drift gate). The non-ignored test frozen_fixtures_match_when_present enforces immutability on every regular run once fixtures exist.

shared_derivation.byte_stream: block_0 = BLAKE3(label); block_{i+1} = BLAKE3(block_i); output = concat(block_0..block_k) truncated to n bytes
shared_derivation.carrier: byte stream via the byte_stream derivation with label "golden carrier: " ++ vector_id, 4096 bytes
shared_derivation.aead_nonce: BLAKE3(salt(4) || packet_id(16))[..12] — exactly the derivation implemented by steganographer-core/src/encryption.rs::derive_nonce; the golden vector pins salt = a5 5a 5a a5 so the ciphertext is reproducible
shared_derivation.content_digest: BLAKE3 over the logical (untransformed) payload, recorded in FIELD_CONTENT_DIGEST as algorithm byte 0x01 followed by the 32-byte digest

documented_test_keys.note: These are DOCUMENTED TEST KEYS, not secrets. They exist so the vectors are reproducible by anyone with this repository.

descriptors.kernel_spatial_lsb: algorithm 0x0001, version 0x01, parameters [0x01] (1 bit per unit)

vectors.derivation: payload = byte_stream(label "golden payload: vector-01", 64); GenericPacket::new_untransformed with packet_id/locator_nonce from the vector id, placement sequential, no transforms, flags 0x0000
vectors.carrier: also verified to embed/extract via the plain sequential spatial-LSB kernel into the synthetic carrier (not a frozen fixture)
vectors.expected_decode: body == payload verbatim; BLAKE3 content digest verifies
vectors.expected_findings: sequential placement, so the STG3 locator magic IS visible in the first 4 LSB-embedded units

vectors.derivation: payload = byte_stream(label "golden payload: vector-02", 72); body = salt a5 5a 5a a5 || ChaCha20-Poly1305-Seal(0x77x32, BLAKE3(salt||packet_id)[..12], payload, aad) — replicates encryption::encrypt with a pinned salt; cross-checked in the test against a fresh crate-side encryption parsed back through the same nonce derivation
vectors.expected_decode: transforms::reverse with the documented key recovers the payload; wrong key fails closed with a Poly1305 tag error; locator flags 0x0002 must stay coupled to the AEAD descriptor
vectors.expected_findings: plaintext body never appears in the packet body; salt is public in the first 4 body bytes

vectors.derivation: packet as vector-01 but placement descriptor = keyed (0x0002, PLC-002) and flags 0x0008; carrier = byte_stream(label "golden carrier: vector-03", 4096) with the packet embedded via KeyedSpatialLsb, key 0x2cx32, 1 bit/unit

carrier.embedding: KeyedSpatialLsb (PLC-002): 8-byte recognition tag at the 64 canonical bootstrap units, packet bits at Feistel KeyedPermutation positions over the remaining 4032 units

vectors.expected_decode: KeyedSpatialLsb extract with the documented key recovers the exact packet; wrong key yields CarrierError::NoPacket; the Feistel schedule over 4032 units is a bijection
vectors.expected_findings: no STG3 magic at the carrier front (keyed stealth)

vectors.derivation: packet as vector-01 but placement descriptor = interleaved (0x0003, PLC-001) and flags 0x0008; payload = byte_stream(label "golden payload: vector-04", 96); carrier = byte_stream(label "golden carrier: vector-04", 4096), embedded via KeyedInterleavedSpatialLsb, key 0x3dx32, 1 bit/unit

carrier.embedding: KeyedInterleavedSpatialLsb (PLC-001): coprime-stride InterleavedSchedule over the 4032 body units; recognition tag identical framing to PLC-002

vectors.expected_decode: KeyedInterleavedSpatialLsb extract with the documented key recovers the exact packet; wrong key yields CarrierError::NoPacket; the coprime-stride schedule over 4032 units is a bijection
vectors.expected_findings: no STG3 magic at the carrier front (keyed stealth)

vectors.derivation: payload = b"alpha-provisional golden vector; " repeated to 198 bytes; Ed25519 signing seed 0x33x32; transforms::apply(sign, compress): sign the logical payload first, then DEFLATE (recorded because it shrinks); flags 0x0011

packet.body_len_bytes: < 198 (DEFLATE of the repeating payload; recorded only because it shrinks)

vectors.expected_decode: transforms::reverse decompresses and re-verifies the Ed25519 signature with no decode-side key; recovered payload == original and BLAKE3 digest verifies
vectors.expected_findings: transform order is sign-then-compress per the platform plan; flags must mirror the sign descriptor (flag⇔transform coupling asserted)

hashes.files: materialized on first fixture run as <id>.hex.sha256 sidecars next to each <id>.hex; the generator test recomputes and compares them on every materialization run

expected_limits.decode_limits: DecodeLimits::default() (16 KiB envelope, 16 MiB body, 128 fields, 16 transforms)

notes: All vectors are generated by the test itself from fixed seeds/keys/nonces; internal invariants (encode-twice equality, decode round-trip, known locator/envelope prefixes, flag⇔transform coupling, keyed stealth, schedule bijectivity) are asserted before any fixture is frozen.

Locator magic, protocol bytes, flags, and envelope field-id sequences in this manifest are hand-computable from packet.rs; the BLAKE3/ChaCha20/Ed25519 derived bytes are NOT hand-computed and live only in the .hex fixtures.
True byte-frozen fixtures land when the owner runs: cargo test -p steganographer-core --test golden_vectors -- --ignored
Fixture set is provisional until that run; a protocol change before then re-derives cleanly with no fixture churn.
